reviews.reason: Matching a finite jet alone is insufficient for the stated conclusion. The proof must organize the presentation and its relations so approximation also controls the entire associated graded ring while carrying the fibred object. This is a concrete H2 approximation task.
reviews.core_assessment: Present the complete local object over a finite-type algebra and encode its relations and syzygies as the input to the G-ring approximation theorem. Choose compatible approximations so that both the prescribed finite jet and the associated graded local ring are preserved, and descend the object to the resulting finite-type neighbourhood.
reviews.prerequisite_assessment: G-rings, limit-preserving fibre categories, Artin approximation in its stated G-ring variant, complete local presentations, Artin–Rees and the standard stability criterion for associated graded complexes. The simultaneous choice of equations, relations and object is the retained proof obligation.
